1.text: When the victory of Allāh has come and the conquest,<sup foot_note="228297">1</sup>

2.text: And you see the people entering into the religion of Allāh in multitudes,

3.text: Then exalt [Him] with praise of your Lord and ask forgiveness of Him. Indeed, He is ever Accepting of Repentance.<sup foot_note="228298">1</sup>
